messages:
inc-bot: PAGER: Detected spike: model_variant=gamma region=us-west-2 5xx_rate=18% latency_p95=2.4s. >100 keys above threshold. auto-escalate=on :rotating_light:
oncall-ml: I’m on it, pulling traces now. Can someone confirm scope (all clients or a subset)?
sre-alex: seeing sustained 5xxs tied to kvcache fetch failures on gamma pods. Errors begin ~13:05 UTC.
eng-ryan: I can take routing changes. If kvcache is the culprit, we should route away from gamma to stable-6 and enable soft quotas for heavy keys.
eng-maya: Confirmed: the error rate correlates with spike in requests that exceed kvcache hotset. There are a few keys from a single partner that are hammering.
product-jin: Which customers impacted? Any paying enterprise?
ops-luis: Quick query on customer impact dashboard: partner-clarity and a handful of internal test keys. No org-wide SLA breach yet but visible errors in their streams.
oncall-ml: plan: 1) engage circuit breaker for gamma routing; 2) demote gamma weight to 0; 3) route traffic to stable-6 fallback; 4) apply emergency quotas to offending API keys; 5) keep traffic shaping for all remaining gamma candidates for 10m.
sre-alex: +1. Recommend doing step 2 and 3 first (routing) to stop immediate 5xxs, then apply quotas.
eng-ryan: Preparing terraform patch for routing weight: set model_traffic["gamma"] = 0 for us-west-2, add fallback model stable-6. Will push now.
eng-ryan: pushing change in staging then prod. command: ```./infractl apply --target=routes/us-west-2 --set model.gamma.weight=0 --set model.stable-6.weight+=0.6```
inc-bot: Deploybot: change proposed by eng-ryan, ci passed, rolling to prod.
eng-maya: While that rolls, I’ll pre-warm stable-6 KV cache and increase VMs. command to prewarm: ```python tools/prewarm.py --model stable-6 --region us-west-2 --sample-keys 5000```
sre-alex: Routing change applied. Observability: 5xx rate dropped to 3% within 30s. lat_p95 improving.
oncall-ml: Good. Now applying soft quotas on top offenders to prevent re-hitting hotset. ops-luis do you have the keys?
ops-luis: listing top keys: ```curl -s https://metrics.internal/heatkeys?model=gamma | jq .top_keys[:8]``` returns partner-clarity-keyA, internal-loadtest-3, partner-beta-key2...
eng-ryan: Applying quota patch (10 req/min for hotspot keys) command: ```./quotactl set --key partner-clarity-keyA --limit 10m --scope region:us-west-2```
eng-maya: Also toggling traffic shaping: reduce per-connection concurrency for all gamma-references (even if routed to stable) to avoid sudden spike to stable-6. Command: ```./routerctl set-concurrency --model gamma --value 2 --region us-west-2```
product-jin: Noting customer impact: partner-clarity may see elevated 429s for a few minutes. We should flag CS to expect messages.
ops-luis: Sending note to cs-alerts channel now. message: "partner-clarity experiencing degraded responses; mitigation in progress; retry/backoff advised"
inc-bot: Alert: CS notification posted by ops-luis.
oncall-ml: Status check in 5m. If stable-6 metrics normal and errors <1%, we can keep gamma demoted and schedule a deeper root cause.
sre-alex: Observability: stable-6 p95 steady 320ms, error rate 0.4%. KVcache misses are still slightly elevated but within acceptable range.
eng-ryan: Rolling rollback action (safety net) prepared in case stable-6 shows degradation: ```./infractl rollback --target=routes/us-west-2 --to previous```. Ready.
eng-maya: I've also pinned a temporary config to disable gamma auto-scaling to prevent churn: ```./autoscaler set --model gamma --enabled false --region us-west-2```
product-jin: Does CS want an outbound customer email? ops-luis: suggest status page update and direct CS outreach only if partner complains.
ops-luis: copied. updating status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation affecting some partner requests in us-west-2. Mitigation in place."
oncall-ml: Followup actions: 1) run KVcache profile snapshot; 2) dump gamma logs for 5-15min window; 3) schedule canary of a patched gamma in 2h; 4) postmortem owner: eng-maya.
sre-alex: I’ll keep paging on if 5xxs rise above 2% again.
eng-ryan: Confirming final state: gamma weight=0 in us-west-2, stable-6 handling traffic, quotas applied to 6 hotspot keys, autoscaling disabled for gamma.
product-jin: Thanks team. Please ensure followup ticket includes customer impact and mitigation timeline.
eng-maya: creating ticket now: RED-4567 "Investigate gamma kvcache degradation + mitigation" and assignees.
ops-luis: handing off to oncall-ml for overnight watch. oncall-ml: taking handoff.\nSYNTHETIC-BOT: resolved? No, monitoring.
oncall-ml: Handoff complete. If error rate climbs, page sre-alex and eng-ryan.
sre-alex: Acknowledged.
eng-ryan: closing this thread for now; will re-open if needed. :white_check_mark:
